items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: So Rochester gets mad because we're dancing and he wants to come over and stop me from dancing with Ethel.

ctx.x: I'm going to do that. So -- the picture was very good and the idea was good because Lena Horne was my girlfriend and Ethel Waters was Rochester's wife. So Rochester played the Sweepstakes and he won and Buck was the messenger who brought him the telegram that he won the Sweepstakes and he took the money he won the Sweepstakes with and took Lena Horne out. That's my girl he's taking out now but Ethel Waters don't know he's got the money and is going to take her out. So Ethel Waters is going to find out where he…

jealous. So we get together dancing. So Rochester gets mad because we're dancing and he wants to come over and stop me from dancing with Ethel. So we start a fight. He shoves me over a table, course it was all set to do, but he did it, seemingly overdid it. He shoved me too hard, they got me to the table sooner than I expected to be, made me hit the table wrongly on the top of my spine, which knocked me cold. So I'm on the floor but I'm out and don't know it but I'm still going through the motions. So I take my…

mean? It's good the Director said "Cut" at the time he did 'cause I couldn't play good no further. So anyway they took me to the hospital, took me over to a room on the lot where there's a first aid kit and got me together good as they could and then I wound up in the hospital; and it was about four or five days before I could get out of the hospital, and then they got with the doctor and told him to patch me up that I got to have him finish the film and they won't let me finish the film because in the contract,…
